description: Election Commission - Notify the name of Nuwan Madhushanka  Fernando Elected as a Member of the Ward No. 18 Maharagama Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government council (Maharagama Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a group leader, and declaration of a newly elected member. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral process and filling elected positions in local government.
